IMATEC is an Erasmus Mundus master in advanced materials and technologies, combining materials design, processing and characterisation across a European consortium. Its admissions page carries the current call, eligibility list and scholarship arrangements for the next cohort.

Programme Highlights

  • Materials-to-manufacturing pipeline with industrial partners
  • Characterisation-lab training across consortium campuses
  • Admissions round announced annually on the official page
  • Careers in materials R&D, manufacturing innovation and doctoral study

Who Should Apply

Materials science, mechanical and chemical engineering graduates fit the entry profile, with laboratory experience valued.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the IMATEC admissions page and submit the application form with the listed documents during the live round. Key deadline information: Admissions round and closing date published on the official admissions page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About IMATEC Consortium

The IMATEC consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Advanced Materials and Technologies with European universities and industrial associates.

Official website: https://www.imatec-mundus.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
